syllabus_topics: Programming with processes, tasks, and files
Organization and evolution of operating systems
The kernel of a multiprogrammed system
Virtual memory and operating system memory management algorithms

assessment_methods.method: Special period practical component (project or practical exercise)

assessment_rules: The continuous assessment project (50% of the final grade) consists of two mandatory exercises, done in groups of 2 students, with a minimum grade of 9.0 values. The project grade is determined by a group evaluation (AvGrupo) and an individual evaluation (AvInd). The final grade in the normal period is 50% project + 50% normal period exam, with a minimum exam grade of 8.0. In the recourse period, another exam can be taken, replacing the normal period exam grade only if it improves it. For the special period, the evaluation is 40% practical component (project or practical exercise) and 60% theoretical component (exam), with minimum grades of 9.0 for practical and 8.0 for theoretical.
bibliography: José Alves Marques, Paulo Ferreira, Carlos Ribeiro, Luís Veiga, Rodrigo Rodrigues, Sistemas Operativos (2ª Edição), FCA, 2012 (main)
Andrew S. Tanenbaum, Modern Operating Systems, 4th Edition, Pearson, 2015 (main)
